name: Earthshaker's Fury
description: From the fire in the world's heart came the land, forever sacred and eternal.
effect: Followers of Groudon may call upon 'Earthshaker's Fury' once per quest as a bonus action during their combat turn, allowing them to summon a swirling storm of earth around a target, dealing their Rank Bonus as damage dice to the target at the end of the round for the next four rounds. This damage ignores defenses. While a foe is suffering this effect, they are considered weak to Ground Type attacks, ignoring any immunity they may have had. At Paragon, they gain a second use of this boon. Gain an additional charge at High Priest(ess). A target can only be affected by one instance of Kyogre or Groudon's boon at a time unless otherwise stated by a GM.
